text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Across the line!! Crowned the Queen of the 
Oaks is—

text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Gh...—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I was so close... but I couldn't reach 
it...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
This year's Japanese Oaks was wild, 
too...! Loves Only You came so close, but 
she's definitely gonna crush it in the 
future...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
The Tiara route is seriously so intense 
this year! Now I can't wait for 
autumn~...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...I understand how you feel right now, 
Love-chan. I couldn't run the way I wanted 
to in the NHK Mile Cup either..."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm going to say it.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
—Telling me that together from here on, 
we'd aim to be the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ――...Love-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Chrono-chan...! ...Good work out there.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: —The Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I intend to continue straight along the 
royal road of the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
And I will prove... to history. That I 
am... one of the Umamusume who defines an 
era.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: What will you do... Loves-chan?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Chrono-chan really understands me so 
well, doesn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...She really understands what gets me 
fired up—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
“—I'm aiming for it too. The next step. 
Because I can't stay the way I am today.”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Because I have to prove that I'm much, 
much stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...That's our Love-chan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went to greet Loves Only You after 
the fierce battle—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...I disappointed you, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. It wasn't supposed to be like 
this, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hold out my smartphone to Loves Only 
You. On the screen—

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"So close...!" "You did your best!" "As 
long as you're safe, it's all good!" "You 
were the coolest out there!" "You did 
great!" "Thank you so much for your hard 
work...!"

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"Loves-chan is our pride!" "I was so moved 
watching in front of the TV...!" "Time to 
take an even bigger leap forward from 
here!!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Everyone—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her run today was so magnificent that it 
made me proud to be her fan. As a fellow 
fan community member, I can say that with 
absolute certainty.
choice_data_list:
So let's keep making your love shine 
bright from here on out!

So let's keep making your love shine 
bright from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Trainer-chan—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...I promise.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I promise I'll deliver even more love to 
everyone than today...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks) 
came to an end, igniting a fierce spark in 
Loves Only You for what lay ahead—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...That night.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I sat down with Loves Only You to discuss 
our future goals—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
“—Even so, what's next is pretty much 
already decided, right? ♪”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A 2000m turf middle-distance GⅠ race held 
at Kyoto Racecourse in October. ...The 
final crown of the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Through this summer, I'll become stronger 
and claim the autumn tiara...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"And let's all celebrate together! Make it 
grand enough to make up for today!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm getting fired up...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, can I tell my channel members 
on stream right now that we're aiming for 
the Shuka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer-chan, can I tell my channel 
members on stream right now that I'm 
aiming for the Shuka Sho?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪ ...I hope everyone looks forward to 
it again♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Toward the final crown of autumn, our 
journey together with Loves Only You 
marches onward—
